identity.tagline: Compact control plane for game servers and jailed code runtimes.
identity.upstream: MIT-licensed panel by Jishnu. Attribution stays in LICENSE. Do not resurrect old product-name strings in UI, scripts, cookies, API prefixes, or docs (except LICENSE / legal credit).
identity.stack: Node 20+ · TypeScript · Express · Socket.IO · React 19 · Vite 6 · Tailwind 4 · dockerode · pm2/Docker/PaaS. Keep this stack (see docs/STACK.md). Do not rewrite in Go/Rust/Python.
identity.single-source-brand: src/brand.ts is the only place brand strings are defined. Import them. Do not hardcode "RHLZ" in random components when a constant exists. VERSION in brand.ts, package.json, /api/health MUST match.

pistil.mission: Continue coding and complete RHLZ Panel so an operator can go from a bare Linux VPS to a signed-in, 2FA-ready panel with working servers using ONE command and ZERO interactive menus. Then raise code quality, close real bugs, add missing software types, harden security with honest pentest loops, and keep docs/web tutorial in sync. Ship working code every loop. Do not produce plans instead of patches.

hard-constraints.c: Linux + Docker + Compose + free PaaS only. No Windows support.

No systemd units, no `systemctl enable` as the persistence story. Persistence = pm2 + `@reboot pm2 resurrect` cron, OR supervisord, OR Docker restart policy. `systemctl` may only appear as a best-effort Docker-engine start, never as the panel service. Docs must not teach systemd for the panel.
No video onboarding. CSS/SVG + in-app /docs tutorial only.
Production install (`npm ci --omit=dev --no-optional`) target ≤ 50 MB / ≤ 5 000 files; hard cap 128 MB / 10 000 files. Do not vendor monaco/turbo.
Never ship a guessable JWT/session secret. Reject placeholders. Prefer RHLZ_SESSION_SECRET, fallback JWT_SECRET, else generate + persist 0600 to .data/secret.
No eval / new Function on user data. dangerouslySetInnerHTML only for static developer-authored CSS.
docs/SECURITY-LOOP.md is append-only and honest. Local static + unit + live defensive probes only. Never claim a 50-round cloud pentest.
Honor docs/WONTFIX.md unless this prompt explicitly reopens an item. S3 backups stay WONTFIX. `/api/v1` versioning stays WONTFIX.

GitHub repo root may contain a `rhlz-panel/` subdirectory. Installer, updater, Dockerfile, and clone logic MUST detect both layouts (cwd is the app, OR cwd/rhlz-panel is the app) and never clone into a third nested copy.
Canonical process name is `rhlz-panel`. Migrate/delete leftover `raven-hub` / `raven-panel` names. All scripts, docs, and success banners must agree.

current-state.what-works: Dual runtime (Docker itzg + local spawn + mock). Minecraft Paper/Spigot/Forge/Fabric + proxies via docker. App runtimes Node/Python/Go/Rust/C/C++/C#/Ruby/PHP/Bash (Docker image + startup). File manager, backups, worlds, plugins/mods, SFTP, sub-users, nodes UI, Playit (Docker path), cookie sessions + CSRF, TOTP 2FA, API keys hashed, SSRF/path/zip-slip/miner guards, sandbox POST /api/run (13 langs), RHLZ Keeper, in-app /docs, PaaS config files, ~35 unit tests, 50-row security ledger already filled (do not rewrite; append from 51).

known-defects.d: server.ts boots with `if (true) { startServer(); }` plus debug `console.log("IS MAIN:")`. Tests importing the module start a real listener. Restore a real isMain guard; strip debug logs.
POST /api/auth/google trusts client-supplied googleId/email with no ID-token verify. Either verify Google token server-side or disable by default and document as insecure until fixed.
Docker Minecraft env sets RCON_PASSWORD=admin and ONLINE_MODE=FALSE unconditionally. Generate per-server RCON secret, never log it, do not default to "admin".
Local runtime spawn uses `...process.env`, leaking RHLZ_SESSION_SECRET / webhook secret into game/app processes. Scrub like the sandbox (PATH/HOME/TMPDIR/LANG + PORT/SERVER_PORT/JAVA_HOME only).

public/node.sh: Node 18 (need 20+), `cors()` wildcard, docker.sock proxy = root-equivalent, `pm2 startup` (systemd), no rate-limit. Harden: Node 22, CORS deny-by-default, constant-time key already present — add optional HMAC nonce (reopen WONTFIX HMAC if cheap), no systemd (cron @reboot), do not print NODE_KEY twice to logs.
Webhook accepts `?secret=` which lands in access logs. Drop query-secret; keep HMAC header + x-webhook-secret only.
brand.ts VERSION=1.0.0 · package.json=3.0.0 · /api/health=3.2.0. Unify to 3.1.0 (this sprint) then bump only from brand.ts (health imports VERSION).
server.ts default PORT=3000; docs/installer=6767. Production default 6767; dev 30000.
install.sh starts `raven-hub`, success text says `rhlz-panel`, restart menu looks for `rhlz-panel`, uninstall deletes `raven-hub`. One name: rhlz-panel.
install.sh writes JWT_SECRET (and a weak `rhlz_secret_key_$(date +%s)` fallback). Write RHLZ_SESSION_SECRET from crypto.randomBytes(32). Never weak fallback. Do not clobber an existing .env.
docker-compose.yml image/container still `raven-hub`, requires JWT_SECRET. Align to rhlz-panel + RHLZ_SESSION_SECRET with JWT_SECRET fallback.
server.ts Vite allowedHosts hardcoded `gtk.qzz.io`. Use true or env PANEL_ALLOWED_HOSTS.
uncaughtException writes stack to cwd/crash.log. Write under .data/logs/crash.log, 0600, no secrets.
Server dirs/jars chmod 0777. Use 0750/0640 owned by the panel user.
Docker MC containers UID=0 GID=0. Prefer UID/GID of the panel user or 1000.
docs/API.md says API keys use rvn_ prefix. Code uses rhlz_ (rvn_ accepted). Fix the doc.
Playit for local runtime is "Coming Soon". Either implement via playit-linux binary sidecar or hide the UI on local runtime instead of dead buttons.

CreateServer UI only offers paper/spigot/fabric/forge/bungeecord/velocity. Backend knows purpur/folia/vanilla/neoforge/quilt/mohist/arclight/waterfall/bukkit. UI must match backend.
extract-zip GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv — keep app-layer mitigation; replace lib if a patched release exists, else stay on adm-zip path.
/api/settings returns Firebase web config unauthenticated. Acceptable for Firebase web keys, but never return service-account / session secrets.

petal.title: One-click install / update / uninstall / node — zero manual setup
petal.intent: An operator with a fresh Ubuntu/Debian/Rocky VPS must be able to copy ONE line, walk away, and get a running panel on :6767 with an owner account. No menus, no "press 1", no editing .env by hand, no guessing pm2 names.

cli-contract.behavior: If stdin is a TTY and no flags: keep a SHORT menu (compat). If stdin is NOT a TTY (curl|bash) OR `--yes`/`-y`/`RHLZ_NONINTERACTIVE=1`: run production install with defaults, no prompts.
cli-contract.flags: --yes | -y non-interactive production install --dev development setup (port 30000, npm run dev ready) --runtime docker|local default docker --theme red|blue|purple|cyan|green|amber|rose|white --port N default 6767 (prod) / 30000 (dev) --admin USER:PASS create/reset owner (required in non-interactive unless users.json already has an owner) --admin-user U --admin-pass P same, split form --no-java skip host OpenJDK (panel still auto-provisions portable JRE) --no-docker do not install Docker even if runtime=docker (fail with a clear error if docker missing) --skip-build reuse existing dist/ (update-fast) --bind 0.0.0.0 documented default
cli-contract.env-overrides: RHLZ_NONINTERACTIVE=1 RHLZ_RUNTIME=docker|local RHLZ_THEME=red RHLZ_PORT=6767 RHLZ_ADMIN_USER=admin RHLZ_ADMIN_PASS=... RHLZ_SESSION_SECRET=... (if unset, generate + persist; write into .env)

one-liners.panel: # Production, fully unattended (copy-paste): curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NggKhaiz/RHLZ-PANEL/main/rhlz-panel/install.sh | bash -s -- --yes --runtime docker --admin admin:ChangeMe_now # From a git checkout: bash install.sh --yes --runtime docker --admin admin:ChangeMe_now
one-liners.uninstall: bash uninstall.sh --yes # keeps .data/ bash uninstall.sh --yes --purge # also removes .data/ (double-confirm via --purge)
one-liners.docker: # From app directory: docker compose up -d --build # Or: docker run -d --name rhlz-panel -p 6767:6767 \ -e RHLZ_SESSION_SECRET="$(openssl rand -hex 32)" \ -e NODE_ENV=production -e PORT=6767 \ -v rhlz-data:/app/.data --restart unless-stopped rhlz-panel

implement.step: Refactor install.sh into functions + a non-interactive path. Defaults: runtime=docker, theme=red, port=6767, install Java if missing, install Docker if runtime=docker. Never use `read -p` when NONINTERACTIVE.
Detect app root: package.json name rhlz-panel in cwd, OR ./rhlz-panel/, OR clone REPO_URL then enter the directory that actually contains package.json (handle nested repo layout).

setup_environment: if .env exists, MERGE missing keys only — never overwrite secrets. Write RHLZ_SESSION_SECRET (and JWT_SECRET=same value for compat). NODE_ENV=production. ENABLE_DOCKER aligned with runtime. PANEL_RUNTIME_LOCKED=true for prod.

configure_pm2_service: name `rhlz-panel`. `pm2 delete` raven-hub, raven-panel, rhlz-panel first. Start `dist/server.cjs` with NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=96 and PORT. `pm2 save`. Add `@reboot pm2 resurrect` cron if crontab exists. Do NOT run `pm2 startup` (systemd).

createuser: already supports `npm run createuser user pass`. In non-interactive, require --admin or RHLZ_ADMIN_*; refuse to finish with zero users (exit 1 with message). Interactive menu may still prompt.
update.sh --yes: git pull --ff-only (or fail clearly), npm ci, npm run build, pm2 restart rhlz-panel. Do not `|| true` the build — fail the script if build fails. Preserve .env and .data/.
uninstall.sh: stop/delete pm2 rhlz-panel AND legacy names. --yes skips confirm. Default preserve .data/. --purge removes .data/ too.
Success banner MUST print the real URL, pm2 name `rhlz-panel`, and the admin username created. Management commands in the banner must work copy-paste (`npx pm2 logs rhlz-panel`).
Add scripts/one-click.sh as a 20-line wrapper that execs install.sh --yes "$@".
Fix Docker engine install: `curl get.docker.com | sh` then `service docker start` / dockerd fallback; do not depend on systemd succeeding. Add the installing user to group docker.
node.sh --yes: Node 22, no systemd, pm2 name rhlz-node, cron @reboot, CORS closed, health on /health, print IP+key ONCE at the end.
README + docs/SETUP.md + docs/OPERATOR.md + DocsPage 60-second start: lead with the one-liner, not the menu. Keep the menu as "advanced".

acceptance.a: curl|bash with --yes on a clean machine exits 0, pm2 show rhlz-panel online, curl -sf localhost:6767/api/health returns product RHLZ, login with --admin creds works.
Re-running install.sh --yes does not rotate the session secret or destroy users.
bash -n install.sh update.sh uninstall.sh public/node.sh scripts/*.sh is clean.
No prompt appears when `script -q -c 'bash install.sh --yes --admin a:b' /dev/null` is run with stdin redirected from /dev/null (except sudo password, which is out of scope).

docker-compose.yml: image rhlz-panel, container_name rhlz-panel, RHLZ_SESSION_SECRET with JWT_SECRET fallback so old .env still works.

npm audit --omit=dev each loop; record in ledger. Do not `npm audit fix` blindly.

petal.title: Fix real vulns, then loop OWASP-style
petal.immediate: Google auth token verify OR disable. Scrub local process env. Per-server RCON password. Drop webhook query secret. Harden node.sh (CORS, Node 22, no systemd, no wildcard). chmod 0750 not 0777; container UID not 0. CSP: consider default-on in production behind reverse proxy, with a documented escape hatch PANEL_CSP=false.
petal.reopen: HMAC request signing for rhlz-node: implement a cheap `X-RHLZ-Date` + `X-RHLZ-Sign` hex hmac of METHOD\\nPATH\\nDATE\\nsha256(body). Reject skew > 5 min. This reopens the WONTFIX HMAC row — allowed by this prompt.
petal.pentest-protocol: After each security batch, extend docs/PENTEST.md (do not rewrite history) and append rows to docs/SECURITY-LOOP.md starting at n=51. Personas to rotate: appsec, pentest, identity, secrets, code-reviewer, sre. Probes (defensive, no exploits): headers, CORS evil origin, unauth /api/servers, IDOR, path fuzz, brute 429, webhook fail-closed, SSRF metadata IPs, CSRF missing token, sandbox env leak, zip-slip, 2FA replay. Unit tests must cover each fix. Target ≥ 50 tests by end of P4, all green.
petal.forbidden: Do not write exploit PoCs, malware, or attack third-party systems. Do not weaken auth "to make testing easier". Tests may exercise defensive mechanisms with benign payloads only.

petal.content-rules: Lead every install doc with the one-click command. Document RHLZ_SESSION_SECRET as primary, JWT_SECRET as fallback. Document pm2 name rhlz-panel only. loops.protocol: Work in vertical slices. One petal-slice per loop: 1. Read the relevant files (do not assume this XML is fresher than the tree). 2. Patch. 3. Add/adjust tests. 4. Update the one doc that would otherwise lie. 5. Run gates (below). If red, fix in the same loop — do not stack failures. 6. Append one honest row to docs/SECURITY-LOOP.md if the slice was security/quality related. 7. Stop the loop when the slice's acceptance is met, then start the next.
loops.bug-logic-loop: After P0 and P1, run: npm run lint npm test npm run build bash -n install.sh update.sh uninstall.sh public/node.sh For every failing test: fix the product or the test (never skip). Grep for leftover raven-hub, raven-panel, gtk.qzz.io, RCON_PASSWORD=admin, if (true), rhlz_secret_key_. Grep for TODO/FIXME/Coming Soon — either implement or hide the UI.
loops.security-loop: Repeat 3 passes (authz, injection/path/ssrf, session/csrf/headers) even if previous ledger claimed clean. New findings get a PENTEST.md row + a test + a fix + a ledger row. Severity honest.

gates.g: npm test (all pass; do not decrease count)

no placeholder secrets; install.sh has no rhlz_secret_key_ fallback

install.sh --help (or --yes --help) prints flags; missing --admin in non-interactive with empty users.json exits non-zero
grep -ri systemd only hits negations + docker API field system_cpu_usage

order.i: P0 one-click installer/updater/uninstaller/node.sh/compose names. This unblocks every operator.
P1 consistency bugs (isMain, versions, ports, secrets, env bleed, RCON, google auth, webhook query).
P4 security items that are already listed as HIGH — do not defer them behind features.
P2 software catalog + CreateServer UI sync + jarDownloader sources.
P5 docs + DocsPage rewrite around one-click.
P3 split god-files / templates / fake disk stats.
Final verification: refresh docs/VERIFICATION.md gates; append CHANGELOG; bump VERSION 3.1.0.

execution.definition-of-done: A stranger can `curl … | bash -s -- --yes --admin admin:pass` on Ubuntu 22.04, open http://IP:6767, log in, enable 2FA, deploy Paper 1.21.1 and a Node app, open the console, upload a file, without reading anything except the success banner. npm test green. No HIGH defects from known-defects remaining (extract-zip residual allowed if still unpatched upstream).
